data.gender_notes: Baseer is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘B-S-R’, meaning to see or perceive. Baseer is an Arabic name for a male, signifying insightful, having insight, or wise. The name Baseer carries the meaning “Insightful, having insight” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Baseer usually hope their child will grow to embody insightful, having insight and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Baseer belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Insightful, having insight.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Baseer total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: بصير
in_arabic.meaning: بصير يعني البصيرة و الفطنة و الحاسة
in_arabic.long_meaning: بصير هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه البصيرة و الفطنة و الحاسة التي تمكن الشخص من رؤية الأمور بوضوح و تفهمها بشكل صحيح. وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَكَانَ لَكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ لِمَنْ كَانَ يَرْجُو اللَّهَ وَالْيَوْمَ الْآخِرَ وَذَكَرَ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا' (الأحزاب: 21)، و في سورة البقرة: 'أَفَلَا يَبْصِرُونَ الْجَمَلَ كَيْفَ يُحْيِيهِ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُهُ' (البقرة: 259). يعتبر اسم بصير من الأسماء ذات الأهمية الكبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: بصیر
in_urdu.meaning: بصیر کا مطلب ہے بصیرت والا، فطانت رکھنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: بصیر ایک عربی اصل کا مذکر نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے بصیرت والا، فطانت رکھنے والا۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں خاصی اہمیت کا حامل ہے کیونکہ یہ اللہ کی دی گئی بصیرت اور فطانت کی یاد دلاتا ہے۔ اس نام کی اہمیت اس لیے بھی ہے کیونکہ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں مختلف جگہوں پر آیا ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ احزاب اور سورہ بقرة میں۔

in_hindi.name: बसीर
in_hindi.meaning: बसीर का अर्थ है बुद्धिमान, समझदार
in_hindi.long_meaning: बसीर एक अरबी मूल का पुल्लिंग नाम है जिसका अर्थ है बुद्धिमान, समझदार। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में बहुत महत्व रखता है क्योंकि यह अल्लाह द्वारा दी गई बुद्धिमत्ता और समझदारी की याद दिलाता है। इस नाम का उल्लेख कुरआन में कई जगहों पर मिलता है, जैसे कि सूरह अह्जाब और सूरह बक़राह में।

in_pashto.name: بصير
in_pashto.meaning: بصير دى معنا دا دى چې پوهيدونکی، سترګې پرانی
in_pashto.long_meaning: بصير د عربي اصل يو مذکر نوم دى چه دى معنا دا دى چې پوهيدونکی، سترګې پرانی. دا نوم د اسلامي کلتور کې ډير اهميت لري ځکه چې دا د الله تعالی د ورکړ شوي فهم او پوهې يادونه کوي. دا نوم د قرآن کريم په مختلفو سورتونو کې راغلی دی، لکه د احزاب او بقرہ سورتونو کې.

in_english.name: Baseer
in_english.meaning: Baseer means having insight, foresight, and discernment
in_english.long_meaning: Baseer is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning 'having insight, foresight, and discernment.' The name is derived from the Arabic root 'b-ṣ-r,' which conveys the idea of seeing, perceiving, or understanding. In Islamic tradition, the name Baseer holds significant importance as it alludes to the insight and discernment granted by Allah. The term appears in several Quranic verses, including Surah Al-Ahzab and Surah Al-Baqarah. The name symbolizes wisdom, understanding, and the ability to perceive things clearly.

data.cultural_impact: The name Baseer holds great cultural significance in the Islamic tradition. In Islamic literature, it is mentioned as an epithet of several prophets and pious individuals. For instance, Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) is referred to as ‘Al-Baseer’, meaning the one who observes and recognizes God's signs and believes in them. This name highlights the importance of inner vision and understanding in one's faith, encouraging individuals to look beyond the physical world and strive for spiritual growth. Moreover, names with the 'Baseer' root are popular among Muslim communities and carry a sense of admiration and respect, reflecting the cultural esteem for wisdom and insight.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Baseer holds profound spiritual significance for Muslims, as it emphasizes the importance of inner vision and wisdom. It is believed that a person with the name Baseer is endowed with the divine gift of understanding and insight, enabling them to perceive the world around them with clarity and wisdom. This spiritual quality can be nurtured and developed through constant reflection, contemplation, and the seeking of knowledge. As a result, the name Baseer acts as a reminder to its bearer of the need to be intellectually curious, spiritually aware, and intentionally seek knowledge to gain a deeper understanding of both the physical and spiritual dimensions of life. By embodying this name, one can strive to become a wisdom-seeker in the journey of life and reach the ultimate goal of gaining closeness to God.
